summary: This video previews the upcoming Season 9 content for Dragonheir: Silent Gods, titled The Undertow Approaches. Key updates include the new Duskport region, nine new heroes, and an elemental affinity shift pairing Ice/Radiance, Fire/Lightning, and Necrosis/Poison. A new permanent cross-server PvP mode called Glory Colosseum is introduced alongside free event heroes Amalfriede and Quirro. Additionally, new Mythic artifacts, equipment sets, and a Magichess update themed Realm of Strife are featured.

heroes.note: A limited hero arriving on November 8th worth saving summons to acquire.

heroes.note: Obtainable for free through the Season 9 Continental Challenge event.

heroes.note: Obtainable for free by progressing through Fey Meander.

meta_changes: Elemental affinities reshuffled for Season 9 into Limpidity (Ice/Radiance), Firestorm (Fire/Lightning), and Necrotoxin (Necrosis/Poison).
Glory Colosseum introduced as a permanent cross-server 3v3 PvP mode with seasonal equipment cost caps and mode-specific shops.
Magichess updated with the Realm of Strife theme, adding 3 heroes, 1 new Bond, new treasures, and the Reversal talent.
tips: Save at least 300 summons before pulling on banners unless chasing limited-time heroes like Anneliesis.
Participate in Continental Challenge and Fey Meander to earn free Legendary and Epic heroes.
Enter creator code suziplays in the Treasure Market when purchasing in-game packs.
